title: Complete H1 matched diagnostic harness
objective: Prepare a seven-pair alternating matched diagnostic timing and attribution harness for the complete Sage.js H1 root and authentic PARI prepared-nf adapter without making a final timing claim

oracles: Exact digest matching and independently derived exclusive-root attribution

handoff.summary: Added a diagnostic-only coordinator for at least seven alternating Sage.js/PARI pairs at the identical sanitized prepared-number-field boundary. It authenticates stable matched result/replay/RNG/work digests, conserves each inclusive root across mutually exclusive named stages plus residual, permits Sage stage counters only behind explicit hooks, enforces whole-root-only PARI, and derives normalized attribution without allowing a final timing claim.
risks: The forthcoming complete Sage.js root adapter is not connected in this lane; deterministic arms test the contract, not runtime performance.
The current draft complete root is monolithic. Its internal work must remain residual unless the integrated adapter exposes genuinely separate operations or audited source-boundary hooks.
No quiet-host measurement was run, and every receipt produced by this contract remains diagnosticOnly with finalTimingRun false.
next_steps: Connect pari_unified_complete_h1_root and pari_h1_outcome_c_adapter after the complete root publishes the standardized correspondence-complete result.
Map only genuinely separate Sage operations to named hooks; leave the monolithic root and all transition overhead residual.
Run at least seven real alternating pairs on a reviewed quiet host, inspect exact digests and raw arms, and retain finalTimingRun false until separate qualification review.
